platform_source.platform: BlueBoat with two M200 motors and weedless propellers
platform_source.added_mass_model: Omitted in this initial rigid-body model; identify before deployment prediction.
platform_source.inertia_model: Uniform planar envelope proxy: m*(length^2+beam^2)/12; not a measured mass distribution.
platform_source.installed_thrust_model: Scale the signed 16 V M200 component curve uniformly so two forward maxima equal the published BlueBoat 8.2 kgf rating. Reverse scaling and intermediate PWM values remain assumptions. No inflow or voltage correction is available.

assumptions: platform.json loading, inertia, drag and installed thrust scaling remain provisional
M200 map is a 16 V static snapshot; voltage discharge and propeller inflow are not modeled
Added mass, wave forcing, motor mismatch/rate and latency parameters are engineering test assumptions
GNSS status is fixed RTK; gyro/position biases and random missing samples are configurable approximations
Stereo uses geometric observations, not generated images or detector inference
warnings: Local linear approximation; large speed/heading departures can leave its useful region
Unbounded local actuator approximation; inspect force demand before physical interpretation
